name: iris-controller
description: Unified IRIS controller: evidence-gated five-step workflow, deterministic project policy, persistent usage ledger, audit, checkpoints, recovery, and registered-tool routing.

author.name: ประสงค์ สีลปราณี

interface.shortDescription: Unified workflow, policy, usage ledger and audit
interface.longDescription: One consolidated controller combines five-step evidence-gated work, deterministic project and budget checks, persistent usage records, audit/checkpoints/recovery, and capability routing for tools explicitly exposed by a host adapter. It does not claim automatic discovery or invocation of every ChatGPT tool.
